title: Fresh confirmatory end-to-end multimodal persistent computation with selected capacity
question: Can the selected integrated PLM configuration learn a fresh held-out cross-modal Boolean task from multimodal observations alone, carrying information through explicit persistent entity-addressed state into a later query and executing the requested computation end to end?
hypothesis: The capacity-selected integrated PLM configuration (hidden_dim=64) will solve a fresh held-out multimodal persistent-computation benchmark above the registered 0.80 q2 threshold without auxiliary payload or entity supervision.

information_flow.pre_action: text/image/audio observations -> encoders -> shared representation -> explicit persistent entity write -> explicit entity read -> fixed query-conditioned CASM -> action
information_flow.post_action: predicted action -> synthetic environment outcome -> verifier -> outcome-gated state update

leakage_rules: E2E-005 heldout compositions and development compositions are permanently excluded from E2E-006 training.
E2E-006 training compositions are disjoint from E2E-006 heldout compositions.
Evaluation is generated after all training steps using a separate RNG namespace.
Training/evaluation semantic episode keys must have zero overlap for every seed.
Query API contains no answer, target, outcome, reward, payload labels, or verifier targets.
No payload-bit or entity auxiliary representation supervision is supplied.
Controls reuse the exact same evaluation episode objects within each seed.
Classifier logits must preserve the action >= 0.5 decision exactly.

decision_rule.condition: all integrity gates pass, mean normal heldout q2 accuracy >= 0.80, and every seed >= 0.40
decision_rule.licenses: bounded confirmatory evidence that the selected synthetic multimodal persistent-computation chain functions end to end on a fresh heldout composition set
decision_rule.does_not_license: real-world multimodal understanding, semantic memory, learned operator discovery, scaling laws, AGI, or hardware claims

decision_rule.condition: integrity passes but primary threshold fails
decision_rule.licenses: selected configuration does not meet the registered synthetic capability criterion

statistics.primary_aggregation: mean q2 per seed followed by seed-level bootstrap

provenance.test_set_use: E2E-005 heldout outcomes are excluded from all E2E-006 training and selection; capacity choice was made on registered development data only.
